verdict.rationale: CRA documents a sanctioned third-party rail. Representatives use the Represent a Client portal to request online access to an account, and businesses can authorize access to their online information. Representatives can also file returns and make payments for business clients, and EFILE provides an enrolled-filer channel using CRA-certified software. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how a business authorizes a representative (authorization levels, scope, revocation), business-specific (non-T1) coverage of the EFILE channel, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
